from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import calendar

def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    # Parse the input date
    date_obj = datetime.strptime(day, "%Y-%m-%d")
    year = date_obj.year
    month = date_obj.month
    day_of_month = date_obj.day
    
    # Calculate target month and year
    total_months = year * 12 + month - 1 + n  # -1 because months are 1-indexed
    target_year = total_months // 12
    target_month = total_months % 12 + 1  # +1 to convert back to 1-indexed
    
    # Check if the original day is the last day of its month
    last_day_of_original_month = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    is_last_day = (day_of_month == last_day_of_original_month)
    
    # Determine the day for the target month
    last_day_of_target_month = calendar.monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
    
    if is_last_day:
        # If original was last day of month, use last day of target month
        target_day = last_day_of_target_month
    else:
        # Otherwise, use the same day or the last day if target month is too short
        target_day = min(day_of_month, last_day_of_target_month)
    
    # Create and return the target date
    result_date = datetime(target_year, target_month, target_day)
    return result_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
